findings.note: under sustained flood each catch-up resets the screen and only ~1-2 KiB of the 64 KiB tail is fed per 20ms slice (FEED_CHUNK 1 KiB), so drawn frames may show a top-anchored partial tail; converges when flood ends. Fix direction: skip draw while catching_up, or feed the tail up to one screenful before drawing.
tail may collapse to few bytes/empty if the only newline is near the end; view-only, harmless.
